# creative-director v0.11.3

> Cited, checkable design rules and a light-touch critique loop that AI agents use to judge and improve visual work.

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): start here; says what to load
- [Core principles](core/principles.md): always loaded; 40 existing rule IDs and compact reminders, others looked up by ID
- [Critique loop](core/critique-loop.md): always loaded; idea, 4–8 roughs, fresh-context same-model head-to-head, owner picks from top 2–3, winner-only fix loop; labelled findings, intervention levels, original-is-better stop; the blocker list
- [Take over](core/take-over.md): when the work is broken: take over or nudge (FLOW-5)
- [Critique template](core/critique-template.md): when writing a critique
- [Commands](core/commands.md): what "bolder", "quieter" and "distill" mean, with checks
- [Energy pass](core/energy-pass.md): only when stated intent calls for energy; calm/neutral work may skip regardless of medium
- [Creative direction](core/creative-direction.md): intent, mood and judging between versions
- [First-principles remake](core/first-principles.md): when asked to redo or reimagine from scratch
- [Which modules to load](core/which-modules.md): task-to-module table and token costs
- [Evidence](core/evidence.md): grades and myths, before claiming people prefer something
- [Retired IDs](docs/RETIRED-IDS.md): rule IDs that moved or merged, kept reserved
- [Modules](modules/): technical-drawing, illustration, character, web-ui, ux, 3d, typography, layout, brand, aesthetic-critique, composition, colour-value, photo, writing, film
- [Photo](modules/photo/README.md): photographs and photoreal images, shot or generated: distance and lens, camera height, light, casting, styling and set, retouch limits, generated-photo tells
- [Writing](modules/writing/README.md): on demand for web/email copy, replies, blurbs, about text, UI microcopy and supporting copy; purpose, honest claims, flow, voice and consistent style
- [Film](modules/film/README.md): cinematography and the moving image, story first (`story.md`): shots, continuity, camera, light, flashing; colour, editing, sound and subtitles in `edit.md`; look vocabulary and myths in `notes.md`; generated-video QC, crossover map
- [Lookbook](modules/lookbook/README.md): optional; 368 established looks and wildcards with tags and image sheets, for from-scratch concepts or work that feels generic; search by use, mood, colour or "more like this"
- [Install guide](docs/install.md): steps for Hermes Agent, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Devin, Cline, Aider, Grok Bot and any chat LLM
- [Skill folder](skills/creative-director/SKILL.md): the same rules as an installable Agent Skill (generated; edit the root files)
- [Prompt bundle](https://github.com/SnazzyGaz/creative-director/releases/latest/download/creative-director-prompt.md): AGENTS.md and the always-loaded core in one file; [full bundle](https://github.com/SnazzyGaz/creative-director/releases/latest/download/creative-director-prompt-full.md) adds every module
- [Lite version](lite/CREATIVE-DIRECTOR-LITE.md): loop, core rules and blockers in one short file
- [Font library](fonts/README.md): theme-grouped free fonts (OFL / Apache) with a catalogue and specimens; shortlist with `tools/font_find.py --mood ... --genre ...`
- [Structured brief and CLI contract](tools/brief.md): `tools/cd.py brief init`, `check` pass/fail JSON (missing evidence never passes), `rule <ID>`, `select` same-model fresh-context packet
- [Tools](tools/README.md): `autocheck.py` runs every measurable check in one go (pass, fail or flag per rule ID); measuring scripts (contrast, grids, perspective, ellipses, intersections, whitespace, balance)
- [Case study](examples/case-study-may-specials/README.md): one sign remade from first principles, with every check shown
- [Blind test kit](examples/blind-test/README.md): 100 briefs made with and without the skill by the same image model, judged blind by the owner of the work; batches 1 and 2 tied 10 to 10, batches 3 to 5 (after the energy pass) went 22 to 7 with one tie, batches 6 and 7 (infographics only, v0.9.4 and v0.9.5) 4 to 6 and 3 to 7, batch 8 (30 briefs over six themes, v0.9.6) 20 to 10; 59 to 40 with one tie overall (p = 0.035, meeting the 59-of-100 bar set in advance, a clear result); screens were the weak spot, and v0.9.7 adds rules for the batch 8 gaps (untested); batch 9 (10 briefs, infographics and screens, v0.9.11) awaits judging; results, keys and caveats in RESULTS.md
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): rule format, grading, example image sizes, rebuild steps
- [Sources](SOURCES.md)
- [Bibliography](BIBLIOGRAPHY.md): annotated reading list on composition, colour and beauty, with links to public-domain full texts
